_comment: Per-file counts of declared-path literals that neither resolve to a file nor carry a `declared-path-literal: <reason>` marker. WRITTEN by `bun run check:declared-paths --update`; a count may only go DOWN. This is recorded debt, not a list of exemptions: each entry is a place where code hardcodes a path `harness.json` already declares. See the module header of scripts/check-declared-paths.ts for why it ships as a ratchet.
